reference_note: Very long text (413K characters). Thresholds restricted to operative cutoffs on a characteristic of a person or firm (eligibility ages and experience, shareholding, market share, coverage, spectrum holdings, advertising-time caps and incentives, revocation triggers, one scope definition). Not listed: maximum terms of concessions and authorizations (Arts. 51, 54, 61, 62, 160), procedural time limits and retention periods, and government quantities (Art. 68 public advertising budget 1-10%, Art. 69 10% FM reservation). Key dates: publication, approval, promulgation, entry into force and transitory application, repeal and phase-in dates; transitory procedural deadlines for authorities (15 business days, 180 days, one-year harmonisation) are not listed. Sanctions: all regimes of Title XIV plus Art. 280 coercive measures.
